messages:
jordyn: Hey infra — PR up for attaching inference GPU subnet to VPC routing table, needs review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/842

jordyn: TL;DR: add route for 10.40.0.0/16 -> nat-gw in us-west-2, and tag gpu-subnet for terraform-managed routing. plan shows no replacements.

jordyn: Diff:
```hcl
resource "aws_route" "gpu_to_nat" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.inference_rt.id
  cidr_block     = "10.40.0.0/16"
  nat_gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.inference.id
}
```

mira: Can you confirm this is only for the infer-gpu-prod VPC? Want to make sure we don't accidentally affect staging.

jordyn: yep prod-only, module used by prod only. added comment and tag: env = "prod"

alex_k: I'll take a look in ~30m

tim: heads-up: if nat-gw is already at capacity for SNAT count we might need to add route to shared-egress. Do we have metrics?

jordyn: good point — plan doesn't touch NAT config. infra-metrics shows 70% SNAT connections on nat-02; I'll follow up if CI flags e2e.

ci-bot: terraform plan for PR #842 succeeded — no resource replacements detected

alex_k: Reviewed. small nit on naming, else lgtm. Please squash the two commits and I can approve.

jordyn: squashed and pushed

alex_k: Approve :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: All status checks passed for PR #842

jordyn: thanks all — merging in 10m unless any objections

mira: no objections, thanks!

tim: ok from me

jordyn: merged. will watch infra-alerts for 30m.
